feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: Fed expected to raise interest rates. And, board votes to close Kennedy Center
entry.summary: The Fed is expected to raise interest rates today for the first time in three years. And, the Kennedy Center board voted yesterday to close the historic center.

entry.title: EU's Ursula von der Leyen says she wants Canada to become an associate member
entry.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen on Wednesday proposed making Canada the European Union's first associate member, a striking overture as U.S. President Donald Trump's tariffs drive Ottawa closer to Europe.

entry.title: Kosovo's ex-President Thaci convicted of war crimes, sentenced to 25 years in prison
entry.summary: A European Union-backed court convicted former Kosovo President Hashim Thaci of war crimes committed during his country's war for independence from Serbia and sentenced him to 25 years in prison.

entry.title: Saudi Arabia calls an attempted Mecca attack a 'red line' as Houthis deny they did it
entry.summary: Saudi Arabia accused Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels overnight of trying to attack Islam's holiest city, prompting condemnation from countries in the region but no sign of military support.

entry.title: Turkish habit of stashing gold "under the pillow' hurts economy, government says
entry.summary: For years, Turks have stashed their gold at home against a raining day, mistrustful of banks. Now the government says that tradition hurts the economy

entry.title: Turks often keep gold as a hedge against inflation. It may be hurting Turkey's future
entry.summary: Billions of dollars worth of gold is held in Turkish households outside the banking system. The government aims to convince citizens to put it into the mainstream financial system to help the economy.

entry.title: State of U.S. democracy reaches new low, report finds
entry.summary: A new global democracy report finds the U.S. at its lowest level of democratic performance in the 50 years it has been measured.

entry.title: SCOTUS rejects Trump's mail voting limits. And, the Kennedy Center financial crisis
entry.summary: The Supreme Court has rejected Trump's mail-in voting restrictions ahead of the midterm elections. And, the Kennedy Center says it is on the brink of bankruptcy and could close soon.

entry.title: Trump says Ukraine and Russia agreed to stop attacks on energy sites
entry.summary: In the face of soaring diesel prices, President Trump claims Ukraine and Russia have agreed to halt strikes on each other's energy sites.

entry.title: Air pollution spiked after the Trump administration stopped embassy monitoring
entry.summary: In 2025, the Trump administration ended a long-running program to collect air pollution data at U.S. embassies. A new study suggests that led to a 24-33% increase in local pollution levels.
